name: Yukari
source:
A kouhai colleague at the same company as the protagonist and her older twin sister Satsuki.  Satsuki’s twin sister. Although she is beautiful, her individualistic and independent nature gives her an aura that keeps men at a distance.

She is an extreme masochist and also addicted to masturbation. Her virginity was taken by the protagonist, while the protagonist was still dating Satsuki. He is the only man who is close to her, because of that Yukari was very eager to have her first sexual experience with him.

[From [url=http://sc-crg.com/katalog/triangle/index.html]official site[/url]]
